title: 🔍 Field Magnifier for BC: Enhanced Accessibility 👓
summary: A contextual field magnifier extension for Business Central improves readability by displaying magnified field content in a floating popup on hover, with three adjustable zoom levels (3x, 4x, 5x), without affecting the rest of the interface.
key_points: Detects hover events on BC fields and extracts caption and value to display magnified in a floating popup
Offers three adjustable zoom levels (3x, 4x, 5x) that grow caption and value proportionally
Implemented using a Control AddIn (JavaScript + CSS) with Page Extensions and Actions for toggle and zoom control
Benefits users with visual needs or anyone wanting better readability without permanent interface changes
Uses a reusable pattern that can be applied to any BC page

quotes.text: The magnifier offers three adjustable zoom levels (3x, 4x and 5x), where the caption and value grow proportionally.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the practical flexibility built into the solution for different user vision needs.

quotes.text: The solution consists of a Control AddIn (JavaScript) + CSS that performs detection and magnification, Page Extensions with a reusable pattern.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the technical architecture enabling developers to implement the feature across multiple pages with consistency.
